title: The biggest Kyle Shanahan, Tony Romo takeaway? Hire a driver.

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: The biggest Kyle Shanahan, Tony Romo takeaway? Hire a driver.
sources.description: Although the recent automobile incidents involving 49ers coach Kyle Shanahan and CBS broadcaster Tony Romo involved different circumstances and outcomes, the situations underscore an inescapable reality when it comes to the transportation options available to people of considerable means.
